purpose: Record a local parser-fed normal evaluation for the canonical untrimmed ACIS cylinder surface profile.

implementation.profile: Canonical circular cylinder represented by the ACIS cone-surface fields accepted by acisCylinderSurfaceFrame (ratio=1, sineAngle=0, cosineAngle=1).
behavior: Requires a finite point, finite nonnegative caller-supplied linear tolerance, and known face sense.
Requires the point to lie within that explicit tolerance of the untrimmed cylinder locus.
Returns the radial unit direction with the retained face-sense orientation.
Rejects points on the axis because the radial normal is not unique.
Leaves the caller output unchanged on every failure.
implementation.numerics: Uses an axis-aligned radial path that isolates perpendicular coordinates and a scaled delta/projection path for general axes; extreme point-origin subtraction uses coordinate scaling.
implementation.claimBoundary: Local geometry utility only; it does not establish native ACIS face-orientation semantics, trims, placement, units, B-rep validity, or consumer support.

generatedCases: non-unit axis with an oblique radial direction
oblique axis where finite point-origin subtraction overflows near DBL_MAX

fixturePolicy: No DWG, DXF, or SAT fixture was added; the test uses the existing in-memory parser-fed SAB control.
supportEffect: No format, consumer, native semantic, or support claim was promoted.
